sources.entry: ezNTFS - Mount external NTFS drives for read and write access with macFUSE and NTFS-3G. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/ixiehao/ezNTFS) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: ezNTFS
summary.one_liner: ezNTFS is a free, open-source macOS tool that lets you read and write NTFS external drives in Finder without reformatting them.
keywords: write to ntfs drive without reformatting
use_cases: Writing files to an NTFS external drive from a Mac
Sharing a Windows-formatted drive with macOS without reformatting
Verifying copied files with SHA-256 checksums
Automatically mounting NTFS drives on connection
summary.what_it_does: ezNTFS mounts NTFS external drives in read-write mode so they can be used directly in Finder. It keeps the NTFS format and existing files intact rather than reformatting the drive. A Copy & Verify option checks copied files using SHA-256. It offers a Safely Eject action and a Mount on Connection setting with per-drive Auto Mount. It relies on macFUSE 5.5.0 and NTFS-3G, and the installer checks for macFUSE and asks to approve a mount service.
notable: Mounts NTFS drives read-write in Finder without reformatting
Copy & Verify uses SHA-256 to check copied files
Listed in jaywcjlove/awesome-mac under System Related Tools
caveats: Requires macOS 14 or later and a separately installed macFUSE 5.5.0
Intel Mac support is still in testing (v0.5.2-intel.1 preview)
May need Full Disk Access granted to the mount service if macOS blocks disk access
